human.summary: Human starting path from Northshire through Elwynn toward Westfall

tasks.title: Start in Northshire Abbey
tasks.body: Begin in Northshire Abbey. Confirm your race and class, learn where the first quest givers are, and keep your inventory clear for early rewards.

tasks.title: Follow your Northshire starter hub
tasks.body: Take the locally available starter quests. Complete nearby objectives together instead of crossing the entire zone for one task. This is an editorial orientation, not a verified quest order.

tasks.title: Prepare your opening abilities
tasks.body: Equip the best usable weapon you have, read your starting spell descriptions, and keep enough room for quest items.

tasks.title: Return to the starter quest hub
tasks.body: Hand in completed quests and collect follow-up quests available to your character. Watch for class-specific starter tasks.

tasks.title: Reach approximately level 5
tasks.body: Continue nearby yellow/green objectives until level 5; some character builds may leave the area earlier or later.

tasks.title: Continue to Goldshire
tasks.body: Follow the local progression toward Goldshire. Take a safe travel path and pick up available flight connections if offered.

tasks.title: Group objectives by location
tasks.body: Choose several nearby quests, complete each objective cluster, and return to the hub when your log has multiple turn-ins.

tasks.title: Visit your class trainer
tasks.body: Check for newly unlocked spells or abilities and purchase useful ranks if you can afford them. Availability depends on class and level.

tasks.title: Repair and restock
tasks.body: Repair equipment, sell junk, keep useful quest items, and replenish food, water, or ammunition when relevant.

tasks.title: Build toward level 10
tasks.body: Quest around Northshire until you are ready for the next zone connection; do not treat the bracket as a strict gate.

tasks.title: Finish efficient local tasks in Stormwind / Westfall approach
tasks.body: Prioritize nearby, level-appropriate objectives instead of long detours that only lead to one turn-in.

tasks.title: Prepare your next-zone move
tasks.body: Check the route into the next quest hub: Sentinel Hill. Set a sensible inn or flight connection before travelling.

tasks.title: Check new class training
tasks.body: Train an available useful spell rank when affordable. Skip expensive low-value upgrades if your gold is tight.

tasks.title: Clear your quest log and bags
tasks.body: Hand in completed starter tasks; keep any story or class quest you intend to continue. These are suggested organizational steps.

tasks.title: Leave the starting circuit when ready
tasks.body: Transition at about level 12. Skyborne and other starter quest timing may change between the beta and release build.

tasks.title: Quest around Sentinel Hill
tasks.body: Use Sentinel Hill as your local base for the 13–18 bracket. Travel between nearby objectives rather than across continents.

tasks.title: Collect level-appropriate quests in Westfall
tasks.body: Accept available quests in Westfall. Check requirements in-game: a category in the beta index does not prove the quest is currently accessible.

tasks.title: Clear nearby objectives in batches
tasks.body: Work through a small circuit of kills, collections, and interactions. Finish several quests in the same area before returning to Sentinel Hill.

tasks.title: Hand in and pick up follow-ups
tasks.body: Return to the local hub, hand in completed quests, and inspect follow-up availability. Do not assume prerequisite chains are unchanged from Classic.

tasks.title: Refresh training and supplies
tasks.body: When passing a city or trainer, check class skills and weapon upgrades. Repair, restock, and use available travel connections.

tasks.title: Check first dungeon opportunities
tasks.body: If you want group content, compare nearby dungeon brackets below. A level range is guidance, not guaranteed entry or quest eligibility.

tasks.body: If the local quests are too difficult, switch to another level-appropriate hub rather than forcing the next bracket.
